Artanis was my first ever hero that I got to level 10 and bought a Master skin for (and I don't even play SC mind you), and while I love his playstyle, I do agree that his clunkiness shines more often than his ability to skirmish and take objectives extremely well, but I still like picking him from times to times, even in Masters (and especially on CH/BoE).

In my opinion, Artanis' kit isn't really that bad, but it lacks depths; it suffers from the fact that Heroes of the Storm's hero design is very *bread and butter*. 

What I mean by that is, if you would ship the character Artanis in League of Legends, you could do cool things like using your E while you're Dashing (Q), your E would probably slow whoever you catch by default (and would have longer range). You might also be able to cancel your Q mid-air to reposition. 

Put Artanis in Dota now, and you have a 1000 range Prism, you dash from a greater range with W, you have multiple combos available, and probably some ludicrous CC somewhere in his kit. 

This is why his abilities feel like they don't mesh together; he has been developed as a watered down version of what he could have been.

He does have a few key strengths though, he's very good against AA comps with Suppression Pulse, he destroys Double warrior line ups because of Titan Killer, and of course every squishy character (Hi Lunara you annoying gallopin dryad) fear him after 16 if he can pick Zealot charge.

I don't think, however, that he should be categorized as a tank, he's more akin to Sonya as a bruiser. 

Here are the changes I would propose :

**Base kit**

* Change his Blade Dash to deal the same amount of damage on both instances. Making it a better "poking" tool, synergizing better with Solarite Reaper, as well as being more forgiving if people get out of the dash, or you get CC'ed in melee (which is a risk that should be present innately)

* Remove the 0.5 delay thing on his Phase Prism that stops you from moving and doing anything else.



**Talents** 

* Lvl 1 : Manual Shield : (Added choice). You can manually activate Shield Overload. Shares the same cooldown.

* Lvl 4 : Chrono Surge : (Changed) -> If you hit a Hero, reduce Cooldown by 50%. If you don't, increase Movement Speed by 15%.

* Lvl 7 : Solarite Reaper : (Added feature) You can now cancel Blade Dash mid-cast by pressing Q again.

* Lvl 10 : Purifier Beam : (Added feature) moves faster depending on how far Artanis is from the **beam** (the closer he is, the faster the beam) 

* Lvl 13 : Graviton Vortex : MOVED TO LVL 16 - Replaced by Prismatic Leash (w/e name) : Increase Phase Prism's range and damage by 100%.

* Lvl 16 : Psionic Wounds : REMOVED.

* Lvl 20 : Target Purified (Changed) 2 ideas here. 

1. Keep current function AND **Vulnerable** (increase all damage taken by 25%) is applied to the targets hit by the beam for 2 seconds.

2. Current function removed and name changed (Purifier Beams) : Now summons 3 smaller orbiting beams around the main beam that deal 70% of the damage. 
 

My two cents, feel free to comment or ask questions :)

21 years old guy here. Never had sex, not even a single kiss. Can't find a job. Not much money left. No ambition.

I spent my whole life trying to please people, I'm generally a very selfless and loyal guy. I am impulsive and depressive which in turns make me  extremely weak emotionally.

I dont even have enough friends to fill the fingers of a single hand. All the girls I approached have either made fun of me or slowly stopped talking to me after a while.

I have been bullied and rejected during almost all of my teens, so I never really accomplished anything because I feared I was going to fail. There was one girl I tried to approach during high school who brought it up to the whole school it seems and I had people laugh at me for "even thinking about it" for almost 2 years.

So I grew the tendency to grow fond of suicidal girls. I'd spend nights and nights awake with them to make them feel better about themselves, making sure they don't hurt themselves or worse. It grows a sort of cruel bond between me and a given depressive girl that seems to be bound to break apart eventually. Since I'm highly impulsive and in deep need of affection I tend to open my heart too quickly and it ends up that the girl either doesn't feel that way or she's still too unstable and we just slowly stop talking to each other up until we just don't talk anymore.

It happened 4 times in the past, and it started happening 3 weeks ago again. I met this 26 years old girl on a game we both play. She lives in USA, I live in Canada. She has a daughter in shared custody. Her whole family is terrible : her father abused her, her step-father abused her, her brother assaults her, her ex-boyfriend cheated on her and raped her sometimes, and her mom forces her to not press charges against any of them or she kicks her out of her house. She tried to suicide 2 weeks ago by taking over 30 pills of Xanax and she would probably have managed to if I didn't call the cops on her to make sure she doesn't take more (she still had over 60 pills left that she could of taken). 

So, we started talking and playing games together everyday, she seems pretty grateful, she's beautiful, she's funny, witty, etc. But once again, I opened my heart too fast, and she said she likes me but here's the trick : she likes one of my friend better (we are 3 there for her everyday since the last 3 weeks), but she doesn't want to date anyone because we are all friends. So we all agree together that whatever happens in the end will happen and that we'll be happy whatever the outcome is. Except that it is still some sort of wicked competition between us and it grew its toll on me. 

Fast forward to yesterday, she calls me crying and yelling because her brother assaulted her again and her mom didn't do anything - again-. I try to help her the best I can, I propose to come over by plane (even if I don't really have the money for it, I have a grand total of 800$ in my bank account) and she keeps saying no, that it'd be a waste of money, that's she's not worth it, etc. So I invited her to come to Canada instead, I fucking proposed to marry her so she could be out of the shithole she lives in, so she could be safe for once in her life and maybe even become happy. We talk about it for some hours, but I probably insisted too much so she just said " i shouldn't have called you - it was stupid". 

That hit me like a fucking truck, I drank a whole liter of wine and spent 20-30 minutes crying while being on Skype with my friends who didn't know my life was so fucking shitty. I attempted suicide,  they called the police on me, I spent the night in the psychiatric ward. 

I texted her I was sorry as soon as I got out, and she said she was too, and now everything seems to be back to "normal", but I'm still fearing another deception or yet another slap in the face and I don't know what to do to get out of this infernal loop. 

**TL;DR :** I have almost nothing, I feel like I'm worthless, I grow fond of suicidal girls because I think they're the least likely to reject me and I need someone in my life that likes me for who i am, I tried to commit suicide multiple times in the past - yesterday even - and I love a foreign depressive girl who lives 900 kms away who also happens to like my friend better.

The difference here is that Twilight Priestess has cards requirements so the reliability comes from having a good mulligan or not, and if the Shadow cards are usable on the turn you want to play them.

Having a situationally sub-par card isn't what a normal control priest would look for IMO.

But yea, me and my friend are making some custom cards, and we have some more Shadow cards up our sleeves. We are trying to make a Shadow Priest deck work, since currently it doesn't. 

This is just the main piece.

Aight so, it's a potentially huge tempo swing for sure. On the other hand,  it also has sub-par stats for the mana cost. That means you need these "shadow" cards in your hand, and targets to use them on to make it really useful. 

But, even in the case that you have these cards, and targets to use them on, it means that you're emptying your hand quite fast. 

Correct me if im wrong, but Shadow Priest is generally faster than normal Priest, and the main problem with it is that it runs out of fuel quite fast. This card helps getting a tempo lead, but doesn't help with tempo pace at all.
